description: LightCraft: An open-source non-destructive photo editor written by scratch in pure Rust

latest_release.name: LightCraft v0.19.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Use crw craftlib by @rwoldberg in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3503
* security(web): ?bench runs on demo photos in an unsaved library, never the stored one by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3646
* #3601: the Square Grid's badge band sits on the photo itself by @rahul05ranjan in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3604
* lightcraft-cli: calibrate walks folders with the engine's bounded walk by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3643
* security(engine): Find Missing Photos hashes only regular files, no further than their size by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3704
* security(engine, faces): index repeated membership scans in photo move, keywords, import planning, sync and rename by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3709
* security(geocode): bound dataset reads, per-line fields, and the inflate error text by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3718
* security(logging): a log message cannot begin a record of its own by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3720
* security(tests): test fixture directories are created exclusively, never reused from a predictable name by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3721
* security(raw): linear sparse planning, distinct-byte allocation bound, opcode list budget, ORF strip length by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3679
* security(engine): sidecar copies, backups and version checks read regular files only by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3677
* catalog: bound keyword list path expansion and index synonym merges by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3641
* security(web): restore plans its writes first; cap render workers by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3669
* security(engine): embed only fonts inside the asset checkout; no line breaks in cargo instructions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3670
* security: staging and probe files are created new, never written through an existing entry by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3673
* security(engine): the library folder is protected from folder.move however its path is spelled by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3676
* security(raster, segment): resample tall narrow images columns first by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3678
* Issue #2249: a teleconverter combination never inherits the bare lens's profile by @eliets2 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3660
* #2361: lens corrections crop inside the corrected photo by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3012
* LR-EDIT-OPTICS-PROFILE: Sigma 10-18 mm exception on the ILCE-6700 by @Enthendor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/2733
* security(lensdb): bound the names calibrations copy, read database files through the opened regular file by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3697
* LR-MASK-GEOMETRY: masks stay on the photo under lens corrections, Upright, Transform and Rotate by @OneSlips in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3550
* LR-EDIT-OPTICS-PROFILE: enable Sony ILCE-7M3 embedded distortion correction (rebase of #1384) by @janickm in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3144
* LR-EDIT-OPTICS-PROFILE: preserve unknown crop factors in lens profiles by @r3d42-git in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/2676
* LR-EDIT-OPTICS-PROFILE: the lens database is offered on first launch and downloads on request, the library is looked up, Optics names the profile by @OneSlips in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3073
* LR-EDIT-OPTICS-PROFILE: the log says where the lens database was read from and what it holds, and warns when it has no

hot_issues.title: Same Light-panel values render brighter/darker than Lightroom (Exposure, Whites/Blacks, Highlights/Shadows; worse for PV 11)
Lightroom catalog import: every original is read in full and hashed, progress stays near 0 % and Cancel waits for all of it (38k photos ≈ 25 min on a USB SSD)
Sony ARW: starting colour muted or flat (A7C, a6400, A7R II, A7R V)
Feature Request: Native Film Negative Conversion Tool (similar to Negative Lab Pro / Darktable Negadoctor)
.CR2 Raw files when imported look washed

detail.readme_excerpt:
LightCraft

Your photos. Your pixels. Your machine.

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文

Photo library and raw development; an open-source, non-destructive photo library and raw developer, built in pure Rust.
Native on macOS, Windows and Linux. In the browser via WebAssembly. Drivable end to end by AI agents over MCP.
